items.headline: JM Financial Research projects no interest rate hikes in 2026, 5% FY27 CPI
items.summary: JM Financial Research anticipates no interest rate hikes by the RBI in 2026, forecasting an average Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation of around 5% for the fiscal year 2027.

items.headline: ICRA forecasts 13-15% revenue growth for India Inc. in Q2 FY27
items.summary: ICRA projects India Inc.'s revenue growth to be between 13-15% in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027.
